newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Xylan trades lower.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Xylan trades lower.

text.p: Xylan Corp traded at 27-3/4 in the after-hours session, down from a close of 28-1/2 on the NASDAQ National Market, traders said Monday.
Trading in the stock followed Xylan's release of fourth-quarter earnings of $0.11 a share against $0.01 a year ago.
"It's not (very) active, but there isn't much else that is really trading," said one of the traders.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 10,200 shares against Friday's 75,000. There was no session two, while on Friday it had a volume of 3,739,200 shares.
